description: Mateo's sentence. 'oil' is ambiguous, so the interpreter asks a question whose options carry the drafts they lead to. The drafts are SYSTEM_PROPOSED structures with a null threshold: no number is invented.

request_body.text: Balanced growth over 8 to 12 years; ESG matters to me; I want to avoid oil and companies involved in significant controversies.

response_body.original_words: Balanced growth over 8 to 12 years; ESG matters to me; I want to avoid oil and companies involved in significant controversies.

objectives.original_words: I want to avoid oil and companies involved in significant controversies

proposed_rules.scope_description: Maximum total equity exposure to companies with a controversy-registry record of nature REGULATORY_FINDING, COURT_RULING, SETTLEMENT. Companies without a record are not assessed: absence from the registry is unknown, never a pass. Bond funds, commodity funds and crypto assets are outside this rule's scope and are not assessed.

clarifications.question: What should 'avoid oil' cover? Only definitions we hold sourced data for can be checked.

options.label: Holdings labelled Energy in what the funds report
options.description: Uses the sector label in each fund issuer's holdings file (and the registry label for direct holdings). Broader than oil: it also covers pipelines and gas.

proposed_rule.scope_description: Maximum total equity exposure to holdings labelled 'Energy': the sector label reported in the fund issuer's holdings file for fund constituents, the instrument registry label for direct holdings. Constituents without a label count as unknown, not as zero. A sector label is not a list of oil producers and is not a controversy finding. Bond funds, commodity funds and crypto assets are outside this rule's scope and are not assessed.

options.label: Specific companies that I name
options.description: Supported once you name them: type the companies in a new sentence and a named-company exclusion will be drafted.

options.label: Companies that produce oil
options.description: Not supported yet: we hold no sourced classification of oil producers, so this cannot be checked honestly.

options.label: All fossil fuels
options.description: Not supported yet: we hold no sourced fossil-fuel classification.
